first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction. Verify the two most directly relevant records before testing a focused simplification, while guarding against improving completion at the expense of qualified revenue or downstream retention.

final.rationale: Run a focused, small guarded test of the shortened onboarding flow, which directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, adoption, and 30-day retention. Do not broadly remove signup fields yet: the SMB result improved qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention and did not generalize beyond SMB. Track activation, qualified revenue, and retention by segment before scaling.
